newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma rises in lively demand.
newsitem.headline: Rauma rises in lively demand.

text.p: Shares in Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy rose in lively demand on Friday following UPM-Kymmene's decision earlier this week to cut its stake in Rauma through offering of shares, brokers said.
At 1340/1040 GMT, Rauma traded at 116.00 markka, up seven markka or 6.42 percent. Turnover was lively for Rauma at 13 million markka.
"Rauma is simply much more attractive now, due to the improved liquidity in the share," one broker said, adding that overseas investors in particular had been buying Rauma recently.
Rauma said in a statement on Tuesday with its Q1 results that the group's biggest owner, UPM-Kymmene would launch an offering of Rauma shares, cutting its stake to around 35 percent from 60 percent.
